title: 第三十四章 暗流第三十五章 卫氏旁支
content_zh:
城东，卫家别院。
这一处院子，在云中城里头不算扎眼。青砖灰瓦，门脸不大，左右两株老槐，门口连个守门的家丁都瞧不见。寻常人打门前过，只当是哪个殷实人家的宅子。
可云中城里有点见识的人都晓得，这院子的门槛，没点身份的，迈不进去。
它是卫氏的产业。
卫氏是什么人家？是这云中城里，连城守都要让三分的豪族。卫家的根，扎在中州，朝堂里有人；卫家的枝，铺遍北境，城里的盐铁、当铺、田庄，大半都姓卫。寻常百姓提起这个姓，没人敢高声。
而这座不起眼的别院，住着的，是卫氏一支旁系——当家的人，唤作卫琰。
这一日，卫琰在堂上，见了个人。
那人一身灰扑扑的短打，相貌平平，往人堆里一扔就找不着，唯有一双眼睛，滴溜溜地转，透着股鬼祟的精明。
是个嗅迹的。
“说。”卫琰坐在上首，慢条斯理地拨弄着手里一串乌沉沉的念珠，连眼皮都没抬，“又是哪桩？”
那嗅迹者躬着身，压低了声音：“爷，城西。”
“城西怎么了。”
“小的这半年，一直在城西一带嗅着。”那人咽了口唾沫，“爷您知道，小的这鼻子，专闻一样东西——‘墨痕’。”
卫琰拨念珠的手，停了一下。
“凡是有人动了那等‘凭空造物’的邪术，”嗅迹者越说越快，“天地间就会留下一道痕，旁人闻不着、看不见，可小的这鼻子能嗅出来。半年前，城西头一回飘起这味儿，飘忽不定，像个还没学会走道的娃娃，一会儿有，一会儿没。小的循着找了几个月，找不准根。”
“可这半年下来，”他抬起头，眼里放着光，“那味儿，稳了。”
卫琰终于抬了眼。
“怎么个稳法。”
“起先那墨痕，又乱又虚，造物的人像是自己都没摸着门道，造一次伤一次，断断续续。”嗅迹者比划着，“可这两个月，那味儿越来越匀、越来越‘正’——爷，这说明什么？说明那人，在练。他在把这门邪术，一点一点，练成自己使得动的真本事。”
堂上静了一瞬。

卫琰把那串念珠搁在桌上，发出“嗒”的一声轻响。
“一个人？”
“小的盯着呢。”嗅迹者道，“城西一间小铺子，一老一少。老的是个游方郎中，姓秦，没什么稀奇。稀奇的是那个少年——半年前不知从哪冒出来的，识字、会算，替人写文书。坊市里都传他‘邪门’，前阵子还使了点怪手段，扳倒了市口那个金牙。”
“小的反复嗅过，那墨痕的根，就在他身上。”
卫琰沉默着。
他端起茶，呷了一口，半晌，才缓缓开口:“城西邪门少年先生……我听人提过。”
他放下茶盏。
“起先只当是个会些市井把戏的机灵鬼，”卫琰眯起眼，那双原本懒洋洋的眼睛里，慢慢渗出一股阴冷，“没往心里去。”
“可你方才那句话——‘造一次伤一次，如今却越练越稳’——”
他顿住了。
堂上的灯火，映着他半张脸，明明暗暗。
卫琰活了大半辈子，见过卫家那门压箱底的本事——“摹刻”。那是卫氏旁支这一脉立身的根本：以死物拓印、伪造器物之能。可这门本事的难处，卫琰比谁都清楚——它“摹”得了形，却“摹”不来神;它得吞服精血来驱，造出来的东西有形无魂，用一回，人就虚一回。族里几代人，为这门伪术折进去多少条命，卫琰心里有数。
正因为知道这门本事有多难、多邪、多耗，他才听出了那句话底下的分量。
content_en:
To the east of the city is the Wei Family Courtyard.
This courtyard is not eye-catching in Yunzhong City. It is made of gray bricks and gray tiles, the front is not big, there are two old locust trees on the left and right, and not even a guard can be seen at the door. Ordinary people would pass by the door as if it belonged to a wealthy family.
But anyone with some knowledge in Yunzhong City knows that no one without status can step through the threshold of this courtyard.
It is Wei's industry.
Who is the Wei family? In this Yunzhong City, even the city guard has to give in to a wealthy family. The roots of the Wei family are deep in Zhongzhou, and there are people in the court; the branches of the Wei family are spread all over the northern border. Most of the salt and iron shops, pawnshops, and farms in the city have the surname Wei. When ordinary people mention this surname, no one dares to raise their voice.
And this inconspicuous courtyard is inhabited by a branch of the Wei family - the head of the family is called Wei Yan.
On this day, Wei Yan met someone in the hall.
The man was dressed in dust and had a mediocre appearance. If you threw him into a crowd, you wouldn't be able to find him. All he had was a pair of eyes that were moving around, revealing a sneaky shrewdness.
It's a sniffer.
"Tell me." Wei Yan sat at the top and slowly fiddled with a string of dark rosary beads in his hand without even raising his eyelids, "Which one is it again?"
The trace sniffer bowed and lowered his voice: "Master, west of the city."
"What's wrong in the west of the city?"
"I've been sniffing around the west of the city for the past six months." The man swallowed, "You know, my nose is dedicated to smelling one thing - 'ink marks'."
Wei Yan's hand holding the rosary paused for a moment.
"Whenever someone uses the magic of 'creating things out of thin air'," the trace sniffer spoke faster and faster, "there will be a trace left in the world. Others can't smell or see it, but my nose can smell it. Half a year ago, this smell wafted to the west of the city for the first time. It was erratic, like a baby that hadn't learned how to walk. It appeared now and then disappeared. I searched for it for several months, but couldn't find the root."
"But after half a year," he raised his head, his eyes shining, "the smell has stabilized."
Wei Yan finally raised his eyes.
"What a stable method."
"At first, the ink marks were messy and weak. It seemed that the person who created the creation didn't even touch the doorway. He was injured every time, intermittently." The trace sniffer gestured, "But in the past two months, the smell has become more and more uniform and more 'positive' - Master, what does this mean? It means that the person is practicing. He is practicing this evil skill bit by bit, until he can truly move it."
The hall was silent for a moment.
Wei Yan placed the rosary beads on the table with a soft "click" sound.
"Alone?"
"The little one is watching," said the sniffer. "There is an old man and a young man in a small shop in the west of the city. The old man is a wandering doctor, his surname is Qin, nothing unusual. What is strange is the young man who appeared out of nowhere half a year ago. He is literate, good at arithmetic, and writes documents for others. It is said in the city that he is a 'devil', and he even used some strange means to bring down the golden tooth at the entrance of the city a while ago."
"The little one has sniffed it repeatedly, and the roots of the ink marks are on his body."
Wei Yan was silent.
He picked up the tea and took a sip. After a long while, he slowly said, "Mr. the evil boy in the west of the city... I heard someone mention it."
He put down the tea cup.
"At first, I just thought he was a smart guy who knew some tricks in the market," Wei Yan narrowed his eyes, and a coldness slowly seeped out of his originally lazy eyes, "I didn't take it seriously."
"But what you said just now - 'I was injured once, but now I am getting more stable with practice' -"
He paused.
The lights in the hall reflected half of his face, bright and dark.
Wei Yan has lived for most of his life and has seen the Wei family's unique skill - "copying". That is the foundation of the branch of the Wei family: the ability to make rubbings from dead objects and forge artifacts. But Wei Yan knows the difficulty of this skill better than anyone else - it can "imitate" the form, but cannot "imitate" the spirit; it has to swallow essence and blood to drive it, and the things it creates have form but no soul. Once it is used, the person will be empty. How many clans are there?Wei Yan knew how many lives he had sacrificed for this fake art.
It was precisely because he knew how difficult, troublesome, and time-consuming this skill was that he could hear the weight behind that sentence.
